VARIABLES pc, x, stack, z, a

vars == << pc, x, stack, z, a >>

Init == /\ x = 0
        /\ z = 0
        /\ a = 0
        /\ stack = << >>
        /\ pc = "L"

P == /\ pc = "P"
     /\ x' = z + a
     /\ pc' = "R"
     /\ UNCHANGED << stack, z, a >>

R == /\ pc = "R"
     /\ pc' = Head(stack).pc
     /\ z' = Head(stack).z
     /\ a' = Head(stack).a
     /\ stack' = Tail(stack)
     /\ x' = x

Put == P \/ R

L == /\ pc = "L"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "L"
     /\ UNCHANGED << x, stack, z, a >>

E == /\ pc = "E"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "Done"
     /\ UNCHANGED << x, stack, z, a >>

Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Put \/ L \/ E \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")
